4) Duration of Moratorium. This moratorium shall be in effect for twelve (12) months following

the effective date of this ordinance or until an ordinance related to data centers is adopted and

takes effect, whichever is earlier. This moratorium ordinance may be amended by the Village

prior to its expiration for an additional time period of up to 6 months pursuant to Wis. Stat.

§66.1002(3)(b)2.
